A '''bioweapon''' was a genetically engineered [[Wikipedia:Pathogen|pathogen]], chemical, creature or device, developed and used as a military weapon. It was often, although not always, designed to affect only a specific species or number of species.

==History==
Bioweapons were used in various times and by various cultures in the course of history. Their use was not exclusive to [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]], as [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|Ship]] remembered the use of the [[plague bomb]] in an ancient war in a far-away galaxy. In addition, the extradimensional [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] were known to employ bioweapons extensively.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named [[Cessik]] contributed to the creation of nonsentient [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] as bioweapons on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]</ref>

The [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] was known to have been involved in the creation of bioweapons during the [[Galactic War]], such as the cybernetically-enhanced [[Flesh Raider|creature]] known as [[Vigilant]], used as a defense system for the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[CZ-198]]. Other similar creatures were also experimented on by the company, under the projects [[Project TG-5|TG-5]] and [[Project EK-8|EK-8]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]</ref>

The [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] was transformed into a toxic wasteland as a result of [[Gene/Legends|gene]]-altering bioweapons used by the Bith during a [[Nozho–Weogar War|war]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

[[File:Blue_shadow_virus_vial.png|thumb|left|150px|The [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] bioweapon]]
Bioweapons such as [[Trihexalon]] were known in the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. [[Rokur Gepta]] used a bioweapon contained in his [[electromagnetic torpedo]] to devastate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], and kill its inhabitants around [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].

During the [[Battle of Loedorvia]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] authorized the release of [[Brainrot Plague|Loedorvian Brain Plague]] into the [[Weemell sector/Legends|Weemell sector]], which destroyed Republic armies and nearly all [[Human/Legends|humans]] on [[Loedorvia|the planet]]. Sometime afterwards, Grievous proposed the usage of more biological weapon usage in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] developed a number of bioweapons during its time as the dominant galactic government, perhaps the most infamous being the [[Emperor's Plague]] and a number of other species-specific agents. After the Empire's fragmentation, the various succeeding Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlords]] continued to develop new pathogens. The most infamous use of bioweapons in Galactic history was probably the deliberate release of the [[Krytos virus]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Ysanne Isard]].

As technology progressed, bioweapons became more refined. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Imperial scientists had developed sophisticated [[Nano-destroyer]]s, artificial viruses keyed to a target's genetic makeup that were not only incurable but also completely undetectable by conventional medical means.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], both sides deployed bioweapons. The extragalactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] destroyed several entire planets, most notably [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], using various biological agents, and infected a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with [[Spore disease]]s.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Although the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] never sanctioned its use, [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] deployed the [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red]] weapon on the planet [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]], wiping out its Yuuzhan Vong population but destroying the natural environment.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Prior to [[127 ABY]], agents of the [[One Sith]] including [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Darth Maladi]] and Yuuzhan Vong [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] [[Zenoc Quah]] sabotaged the joint Jedi-Yuuzhan Vong [[Ossus Project]] which aimed to [[Terraforming/Legends|terraform]] war-torn worlds.<ref name="SWL44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref> They infected the terraforming processes with the [[Vongspawn virus]] that caused flora and fauna to mutate and painful growths to appear on sentients. The ensuing tensions sparked the [[Sith–Imperial War]] which consolidated Sith-[[Fel Empire|Imperial]] dominance over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[130 ABY]].<ref name="SWL0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the Sith scientist [[Vul Isen]] developed [[viral spore]]s capable of poisoning all organisms on a planet's oceans within days, rendering it uninhabitable. These were deployed as part of the [[Genocide on Dac|Mon Calamari Genocide]] on Dac and later on [[Da Soocha]].<ref name="SWL47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref><ref name="SWL48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref>

By [[138 ABY]], Darth Maladi had developed an improved version of Alpha Red known as [[Omega Red]] which was capable of eradicating entire species. Following the deployment of [[Darth Krayt]] [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|elite Sith troopers]] during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|Battle]] of [[Taivas]], Emperor [[Roan Fel]] made a deal with Maladi to deploy the weapon during an [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|assault]] on Coruscant. In reality, this played into the hands of her master Darth Krayt. It was capable of destroying all sentient lifeforms with the exception of members of the One Sith who were immune to its effects. However, Fel was killed by [[Antares Draco]] before he could deploy the deadly bioweapon on Coruscant.<ref name="SWLW5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref>

==Workings and use==
Bioweapons could be synthetically developed, such as Nano-destroyers, or refined from existing substances, such as the Alpha Red pathogen, which was refined from [[Bafforr tree]] pollen. While most bioweapons did not see general use (those employed by the Yuuzhan Vong being the exception), they could be used for a variety of purposes. Lethal pathogens such as the [[Hive virus]] could be used for annihilating entire populations, while others were more subtle. For example, the [[Vira606]] was administered by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] to some of its agents, making them dependent on constant antiserum injections and ensuring their loyalty.
